This unique place has a style all its own. This is a 1BD apartment right in the heart of Nashville Downtown. This Luxury apartment building was  built in 2022.

This is a brand new apartment in a new building. The apartment features a King Size bed in the room,washer and dryer in unit,full bathroom with combination shower/tub.Also features smart Tv(Netflix ready) in the living room area,quality furniture pieces and a beautiful downtown view from the living area. Other appliances such iron(with iron board) kettle,rice maker,coffee maker,fridge,electric stove,freezer,ice machine etc in unit. Utensils, plates,wine glasses, mugs,cups also provided. The bathroom is fully stocked with wash cloths,towels,conditioner,shampoo,body wash,toilet roll,paper towels. Apartment also comes with FREE WIFI.
